edits.oldText: final cassetteCfg = cfg is CassetteScreenConfig ? cfg as CassetteScreenConfig : null;
edits.newText: final CassetteScreenConfig? cassetteCfg = cfg is CassetteScreenConfig ? cfg : null;

if (cassetteCfg != null) ...[
          _Cycle(
            'void-settings-cassette-variant',
            'variant',
            cassetteVariantMeta[cassetteCfg.variant]!.label,
            () {
              final next = CassetteVariant.values[
                  (cassetteCfg.variant.index + 1) %
                      CassetteVariant.values.length];
              settings.saveScreenConfig(cassetteCfg.copyWith(variant: next));
            },
          ),
          textSize(
              'void-settings-cassette-text-size',
              cassetteCfg.textScale,
              (v) => cassetteCfg.copyWith(textScale: v)),
          _Toggle(
            'void-settings-cassette-haptics',
            'haptics',
            cassetteCfg.hapticsEnabled,
            () => settings.saveScreenConfig(
                cassetteCfg.copyWith(hapticsEnabled: !cassetteCfg.hapticsEnabled)),
          ),
        ],
